programId.description: The id of the program this transaction belongs to

memberId.description: The ID of the member in the program this transaction belongs to

amount.description: The number of points of the definition this transaction gives

pointDefinitionId.description: The id of the point definition this transaction gives points of

pointDefinitionReference.description: The reference of the point definition this transaction gives points of

pointPeriodId.description: The id of the point period this transaction belongs to, if applicable

createdAt.description: The date and time when the transaction was created

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the transaction was last updated

expireAt.description: The date and time when the transaction expires. If null, the transaction never expires.

cancelledAt.description: The date and time when the transaction was cancelled. If not null, the transaction is valid until this time.

validFrom.description: The date and time the transaction is valid from.
